adjudicated.assessment: The compact statement that he sets off is conveyed, albeit in slightly formal English.
His recollective address to Miki is functionally preserved.
The action of stopping is exact.

adjudicated.jp: 大切なことを伝え忘れていた。
adjudicated.en: I forgot to tell her something very important.
adjudicated.assessment: He accurately recalls having forgotten to tell her something important.
The responsive 'Yes?' naturally conveys her acknowledgment.

adjudicated.jp: 「そろそろ部活、活動再開するってさ」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "I'm hearing that Club is going to be starting up again any time now."
comments: This is intended to be read as Misato having said this, but of course it's a lie. Left it a little ambiguous. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: He reports that club activities will be resuming soon. 'I'm hearing that Club' treats the activity as a proper-named entity and uses a needlessly progressive reporting construction, producing malformed dialogue.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'I hear club activities are starting up again soon.'

highlights.text: I'm hearing that Club is going to be starting up again any time now
